visualVariables.valueExpression:
var Acres = $feature.DailyAcres
var Age = $feature.FireDiscoveryAge
var Type = $feature.IncidentTypeCategory
var vs = $view.scale

var ValueSize = When (
    Type == 'RX', 17, //Prescribed Fire
    Type == 'CX', 18, //Incident Complex
    Age == 0, 19.5, //Past 24-hour
    Acres < 1000, 18, //0-999
	Acres < 10000, 25, //1,000-9,999
	Acres < 50000, 33, //10,000-49,999
	Acres < 300000, 41, //50,000-299,999
47 //300,000 or more
)

When(
vs > 9000000, ValueSize,
vs > 4000000, 1 + ValueSize,
vs > 2000000, 2 + ValueSize,
vs > 1000000, 3 + ValueSize,
vs > 500000, 4 + ValueSize, 5 + ValueSize)

fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"Unique object identifier for the feature record.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: IncidentName
fields.description: {"value":"Name assigned to the wildfire incident.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: IncidentTypeCategory
fields.description: {"value":"A sub-group of the Event Kind code and description that further breaks down the Event Kind into more specific event categories.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: UniqueFireIdentifier
fields.description: {"value":"Unique identifier assigned to the wildfire incident.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: DailyAcres
fields.description: {"value":"Number of acres reported as affected by the fire for the current reporting period.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: CalculatedAcres
fields.description: {"value":"A measure of acres calculated (i.e., infrared) from a geospatial perimeter of a fire.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: PercentContained
fields.description: {"value":"Percentage of the fire perimeter that is contained.","fieldValueType":"percentageOrRatio"}

fields.name: ICS209ReportDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"Date and time of the latest ICS-209 incident report.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: FireDiscoveryDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"The date and time a fire was reported as discovered or confirmed to exist. May also be the start date for reporting purposes. ","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: DiscoveryAcres
fields.description: {"value":"Estimated acreage of the fire when it was discovered.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: POOCounty
fields.description: {"value":"The county name identifying the county or equivalent entity at point of origin designated at the time of collection. ","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: POOState
fields.description: {"value":"State where the fire's point of origin is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: FireCause
fields.description: {"value":"Broad classification of the reason the fire occurred identified as human, natural or undetermined.  ","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: FireCauseGeneral
fields.description: {"value":"Agency or circumstance which started a fire or set the stage for its occurrence; source of a fire's ignition.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: GACC
fields.description: {"value":"A code that identifies one of the wildland fire geographic area coordination centers that is responsible for the incident area.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: TotalIncidentPersonnel
fields.description: {"value":"Total number of personnel assigned to the incident.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: IncidentManagementOrganization
fields.description: {"value":"Organization responsible for managing the incident.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: FireMgmtComplexity
fields.description: {"value":"The highest management level utilized to manage a wildland fire event.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: ResidencesDestroyed
fields.description: {"value":"The total number of residences destroyed, or damaged to an extent requiring rebuilding, as a result of a fire.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: OtherStructuresDestroyed
fields.description: {"value":"Number of non-residential structures destroyed by the fire.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: Injuries
fields.description: {"value":"The total number of reportable occupational injuries and illnesses that occurred in conjunction with an incident.  ","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: Fatalities
fields.description: {"value":"The total number of fatalities of personnel assigned to an incident.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: PredominantFuelGroup
fields.description: {"value":"The fuel majority fuel model type that best represents fire behavior in the incident area, grouped into one of seven categories.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: PredominantFuelModel
fields.description: {"value":"Describes the type of fuels found within the  majority of the incident area.   ","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: PrimaryFuelModel
fields.description: {"value":"Primary fuel model associated with the fire incident.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: ContainmentDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"The date and time a wildfire was declared contained.  ","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: ControlDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"The date and time a wildfire was declared under control. ","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: FinalAcres
fields.description: {"value":"Final reported acreage of the fire.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: IsValid
fields.description: {"value":"Indicates whether the incident is active within IRWIN","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: FireOutDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"The date and time when a fire is declared out.  ","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: ModifiedOnDateTime
fields.description: {"value":"Date and time the incident record was last modified.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: IncidentTypeKind
fields.description: {"value":"Specific kind or classification of the incident.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: IrwinID
fields.description: {"value":"Unique identifier assigned to the incident by IRWIN","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: GlobalID
fields.description: {"value":"Globally unique identifier for the incident record.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: ModifiedOnAge
fields.description: {"value":"Number of days since the incident record was last modified.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: FireDiscoveryAge
fields.description: {"value":"Number of days since the fire was discovered.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: MaxAcres
fields.description: {"value":"Maximum value between Daily Acres and Calculated Acres.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}
